fields.headline: All Calloway Falls schools closed today because of smoke
fields.threshold: Schools close when the forecast AQI stays above 150 for the school day.
fields.schools: Calloway Falls Elementary, Calloway Middle and Calloway High School
fields.details: No classes or buses. Meals can be picked up at the high school from 11 AM to 1 PM. After-school activities are canceled.
fields.reopening: We will decide by 5 PM whether schools open Tuesday.

fields.headline: Early release at 12:30 PM because of smoke
fields.threshold: Schools release early when the AQI reaches 125 and is forecast to rise.
fields.details: Buses leave at 12:30 PM. Outdoor activities are canceled; students with asthma may go home now.

fields.headline: Indoor day: recess and sports moved inside
fields.threshold: Outdoor activity moves inside when the AQI is above 100.
fields.details: Classes meet normally. Air handlers run with the highest rated filters; windows stay closed.
